title: Research note: certify shared parity decoder frame dimensions
body: Scoped research note / negative result; no new kappa claim. The standalone checker passes and the patch is based on 66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60. Full make verify remains outstanding: frontier626-verify stops in the inherited bit543 check because regenerated and shipped gzip files differ byte-for-byte, although their decompressed contents have the same SHA-256 (e597e3885c0a8daa262afa5985ee2930443329126aece76d33159d81882bdcc2). Not marking ready pending resolution or reviewer guidance on that check.
